newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland - December 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland - December 24.

text.p: Following are the highlights of stories reported in the Irish press on Tuesday.
- Irish police probe the murder of a French woman who was found in a lane leading to a holiday home she had moved into in West Cork.
- Loyalists said they will match IRA blow for blow and leave the question of war or peace in the hands of the IRA.
- A man who has been seriously ill in New York for the last 21 years should get access to his full mediacal records from two Dublin hospitals the Department of Health indicated.
- Grafton Group in six million deal for Rathmines Plaza hotel.
- Central Bank to take hard look at growth in credit.
- Escalation of violence feared in Northern Ireland.
- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is planning to move its funds administration activities from London into Dublin's International Financial Services Centre.
- 360 prisoners to get temporary Christmas release, including 20 republicans.
- Bank of Ireland gets clearance for takeover of Bristol & West.
- Scheme to save Cityjet lodged in High Court by group's examiner.
